name: shipcheck-action
description: GitHub Action wrapper for Shipcheck release-readiness scans.

scripts.check:sarif: npx --yes shipcheck-cli@0.4.5 test-fixtures/basic-js --format sarif --fail-on high > shipcheck.sarif && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('shipcheck.sarif', 'utf8')); if (data.version !== '2.1.0') throw new Error('Invalid SARIF version');"
